session.description: Problem 9 live session: the three open tickets worked by the agent team on gpt-6-luna, started and approved by Doug from the React board.
session.database: data/campus_customs_new.db (reset to the original values right before the session)

tickets.request: 1 x Classic Bulldog Tee (CC-TEE-WHITE), size S
tickets.short_outcome: Size S was out of stock (0 on hand) and the reprint on invoice 501 could not ship until paid. Doug approved the $840 invoice and it was paid on 2026-08-31, starting Bulldog Print Co's 5-day lead time. The tee is expected 2026-09-05; the customer has an honest draft update. The shop date never advances in the simulation, so the ticket correctly rests at waiting_on_vendor.

agents.boss: Read the ticket, cash position, and queue; delegated inventory and accounting together, then customer service; after Doug's approval had inventory confirm the restock date and customer service update the draft; set status waiting_on_human, then waiting_on_vendor.
agents.inventory: Found 0 size S on hand (shortfall 1); confirmed invoice 501 is the size-S reprint, unpaid and 3 days overdue; after payment confirmed expected arrival 2026-09-05; did not reserve stock because nothing was on the shelf.
agents.accounting: Checked the $3,400 balance against rent due 2026-09-02; filed payment request #1 for $840, noting rent plus the invoice leaves $160.
agents.customer_service: Draft #1 told Tauhid size S is out and no date can be promised while the invoice is unpaid; draft #2 (after payment) gives Sept 5 as an estimate, not a guarantee. Neither was sent.
agents.facilities: Not used (no lease or space involved).

human_approvals.what: Pay invoice 501, Bulldog Print Co rush reprint

tickets.short_outcome: Facilities verified the email against lease 1 (Elm City Properties, Chapel Street shop, $2,400, due 2026-09-02, 2 days out, nothing yet paid). Accounting requested payment; Doug approved and $2,400 was paid on 2026-08-31, before the due date. Ticket resolved.

agents.boss: Read the ticket, cash, and queue; delegated facilities and accounting together; after Doug's approval had both confirm the payment; set waiting_on_human, then resolved.
agents.facilities: Verified landlord, space, amount, and due date against lease 1 and that no rent payment or request already existed; after payment confirmed payment #2 satisfies the notice.
agents.accounting: Confirmed $2,400 due 2026-09-02 against $2,560 in checking; filed payment request #2; after payment confirmed $160 remains.
agents.customer_service: Not used; the boss judged no landlord message was needed.

human_approvals.what: Pay rent on lease 1 (Chapel Street shop)

tickets.request: 20 x Basic Hoodie Big Yale (CC-HOOD-NAVY), size M, at a bulk discount
tickets.short_outcome: Doug started this ticket with instructions: "See if we have enough and if we can afford to this one. We are running low on cash." Inventory found only 8 of 20 size M on hand (short 12, no restock on file). Accounting proposed 15% off, $49.30 each ($27.30 above the $22 cost), filed as price override #3 for 20 units ($986), and flagged that buying 12 more at $22 cost (~$264) is more than the $160 left. Doug approved the price (no money moved). Customer service drafted a reply giving the approved price and asking the club whether to keep checking for all 20 or revise the quantity. The ticket waits on the club.

agents.boss: Passed Doug's instructions on; delegated inventory first, then accounting and customer service together with inventory's count; after Doug's approval sent all three back to act on it; set waiting_on_human, then in_progress.
agents.inventory: Found 8 size M on hand (S 4, L 14, XL 6), a 12-unit shortfall, no linked restock invoice; Bulldog Print Co can reprint apparel in 5 days but nothing is ordered; did not reserve stock.
agents.accounting: Tested prices with quote_price, recommended 15% off at $49.30 and filed price override #3 (20 x $49.30 = $986 vs $1,160 at list); warned the $160 balance cannot fund a 12-unit restock; after approval noted it is a price concession, not a payment.
agents.customer_service: Draft #3 offered the 8 in stock with no discount promised; draft #4 (after approval) states $49.30 each and asks the club to confirm quantity. Neither was sent.
agents.facilities: Not used (no lease or space involved).
